Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Partner Sales Manager to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.
Working the the Partner Sales Director in their geographic region, the Senior Partner Sales Manager will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level.

They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

Position Summary Ironmark is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to support franchisees and local operators participating in multi-location marketing programs.

This role serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned locations, helping them understand available services, make informed marketing decisions, and get greater value from their investment.

The Strategic Account Manager connects each location’s business goals with coordinated execution across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and marketing technology.

They guide onboarding, maintain proactive communication, explain performance clearly, and help local owners navigate priorities, opportunities, and challenges. The right person will bring digital agency experience, a strong understanding of multi-location marketing, and the confidence to manage a large portfolio of local client relationships.

They should be comfortable advising business owners, interpreting performance, resolving concerns, and coordinating work across internal service teams.

Primary Responsibilities & Ownership The Strategic Account Manager owns the day-to-day experience, health, and growth of assigned location relationships, ensuring each client receives clear guidance, responsive support, and a consistent experience within the broader brand program.

Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned franchisees, local operators, and participating locations. Lead recurring location meetings, performance conversations, onboarding sessions, and planning discussions. Translate each location’s business goals, market conditions, and budget into clear marketing priorities and next steps.

Coordinate integrated programs across paid media, SEO, social media, content, creative, web, analytics, print, and other services. Monitor location satisfaction, engagement, program adoption, performance trends, and potential risks across the assigned portfolio.

Proactively address concerns and lead difficult location-level conversations with clarity, professionalism, and sound judgment. Partner with channel specialists to interpret performance and present practical, business-focused recommendations.

Identify opportunities to improve retention, increase service adoption, and expand location participation through relevant Ironmark services.

Key Areas of Focus Location Relationship Management & Strategic Guidance Build credibility with franchisees and local operators by understanding their business goals, market conditions, challenges, and growth priorities. Help location clients prioritize marketing opportunities based on business impact, available budget, and operational readiness.

Multi-Location Program Management Manage a scalable portfolio of location relationships within larger franchise and multi-location programs. Lead location onboarding, education, adoption, and ongoing engagement across available marketing services.

Deliver a consistent client experience while adapting guidance to each location’s market, maturity, goals, and needs. Digital Marketing Strategy & Performance Understand how paid media, SEO, content, social media, web, analytics, and related services work together.

Review performance with channel experts and translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications. Connect brand-level strategy and reporting with practical location-level execution, performance, and next steps.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Growth Coordinate between location clients and Ironmark ’s strategy, media, SEO, creative, web, analytics, operations, and production teams. Create clear internal direction, confirm ownership, surface risks early, and keep deliverables moving.

Partner with leadership on location retention, account planning, service adoption, and opportunities to expand participation. Qualifications Required 4+ years of client-facing account management, strategy, or client services experience in a digital marketing agency. Direct experience supporting franchise or another multi-location business model.

Experience managing a large portfolio of client relationships, workstreams, timelines, and stakeholders at the same time. Working knowledge of paid media, SEO, content, web, analytics, and performance reporting. Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful trends, and communicate practical recommendations to local business owners.

Strong written, verbal, presentation, and relationship-building skills, including the ability to navigate difficult client conversations professionally. Preferred Experience working directly with franchisees, dealers, local operators, or individual locations within a larger brand system.

Familiarity with CRM, project management, reporting, call tracking, and marketing automation tools. What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The ideal candidate understands that strong location account management is more than responsiveness.

They anticipate needs, create clarity, connect marketing activity to local business goals, and help owners make better decisions while maintaining a consistent client experience across a large portfolio.

They understand the complexity of multi-location marketing and can earn trust with franchisees and local operators who need practical guidance, reliable follow-through, and measurable value. They communicate directly, stay organized, remain calm under pressure, and bring the right internal resources together to solve problems.

Why Join Ironmark Ironmark is a growing marketing services company that brings digital, creative, print, production, data, and technology together for multi-location and franchise brands.

This role is an opportunity to work with complex client organizations, shape scalable marketing programs, and help clients connect national strategy with meaningful local-market execution. EEO Statement Ironmark is an equal opportunity employer.

Redwood is localizing a global battery supply chain that seamlessly integrates recovery, reuse, and recycling — keeping critical minerals in circulation and driving the energy transition. In this position, you will be responsible for managing relationships with consumer technology and device companies and establishing partnerships to source and recycle lithium-ion batteries.

This position will include strategic account planning, account development, relationship management, and sales management across consumer technology partnerships.

You will also serve as the commercial point person for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, a consumer-facing collection initiative that places battery drop-off bins at high-traffic community locations. You’ll work with business and technical teams across Redwood, collaborating to solve business problems with multiple stakeholders.

The person who takes on this challenge, if successful, will be instrumental in paving the way for how this industry is shaped and the future of sourcing at Redwood. Responsibilities will include:
Build, foster and maintain relationships with consumer technology companies and device manufacturers to coordinate multi-level partnerships for the collection and recycling of lithium-ion battery materials. Align multiple locations and global stakeholders when necessary.
Serve as the primary point of contact for consumer technology partnership, managing end-to-end account relationships from initial engagement through long-term partnership execution. Understand each partner’s product lifecycle, sustainability commitments, and battery disposal needs to position Redwood as their preferred recycling partner.

Accountable for making sure the business is on track – ensuring a strong mix of consumer technology partnerships, that we’re exceeding customer expectations, and that battery material is procured profitably considering sourcing cost, operating costs, and logistics cost to feed the machine that is producing the most sustainable battery materials in the world.
Recognize customers’ product roadmaps and sustainability programs in detail, aligning our resources to the right programs and priorities, as well as identifying future growth opportunities in the consumer electronics battery sourcing space.
Understand customers’ value chain and the influences of each player in the ecosystem. Direct global resources to manage the value chain appropriately as well as negotiate the various contracts (volume, prices, all other T&Cs) with customers.
Own business development and operational oversight for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, including partner pipeline development, outreach, proposals, contracting, and expansion planning.
Identify, prioritize, and develop relationships with Battery Bin host partners, including retailers, municipalities, universities, nonprofits, and public agencies. Evaluate deployment opportunities and lead the end-to-end launch process from partner qualification through go-live and ongoing account management.
Develop partnership models and partner-facing materials for Battery Bin deployments, including grant-funded, leased, sponsored, or paid service structures, as well as pitch decks, implementation guides, FAQs, and related collateral.
Track and report performance across consumer device partnerships and Battery Bin sites, using data to improve partner targeting, operational efficiency, cost-to-serve, and overall program economics.
Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, logistics, legal, policy, communications, and compliance teams to ensure partnerships and collection programs are compliant, high impact, and operationally sustainable.

Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.
Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.
Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.
VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).
Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.
Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.
Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Business Development oder Sales), oder im VC-Umfeld gesammelt
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energiewirtschaft, Entrepreneurship oder einem verwandten Feld)
Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit

Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst

Deine Aufgaben
Mission der Rolle
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Gründer Julius (CEO) zusammen und bist wesentlicher Bestandteil unserer Enterprise Unit.
Dein Ziel: Du überzeugst die größten Portfoliobesitzer von Mehrfamilienhäusern deutschlandweit von VREY. Dabei arbeitest du aktiv am Aufbau unserer Business Unit "Enterprise" mit und verkaufst selbst an Wohnungsimmobilien- und Genossenschaften, um Bedürfnisse tiefgreifend zu verstehen.

Du bist einer der ersten zwei Vollzeit-Hires im Enterprise Team und arbeitest eng mit unserem CEO zusammen, um den Kanal effizient und reproduzierbar zu machen

Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal.
We’re a growth marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands.
We believe scale isn’t about bigger budgets but smarter decisions. Our team has helped brands across the globe generate over $1 billion in revenue by combining sharp strategy, bold creativity, and hands-on execution.
We’re designed for the digital era, where everything evolves at the speed of light. Our work evolves alongside it, adapting to the industries, platforms, and audiences we help grow.
We partner with some of the world’s fastest-growing brands, from disruptive startups to global household names, to turn marketing spend into measurable business growth.

We’re looking for a full-time Business Development Manager who can turn great work into consistent growth.
You’ll take qualified opportunities and turn them into long-term client relationships, leading conversations from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close. You’ll speak directly with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers, digging into how their businesses actually grow and where Acceler8 can make a meaningful difference.
This is a senior, sales-focused role for someone who understands growth marketing beyond the campaign level. You’ll connect paid media, creative, conversion, retention, and measurement to the commercial realities of a business, then translate those opportunities into a compelling reason to work with Acceler8.
You’ll support the top of funnel through prospecting and lead generation, as well as Acceler8’s founders and leadership team on high-value opportunities, proposals, pricing, and closing strategy.

s.h: As a Business Development Manager, you will
s.t:
Take ownership of qualified opportunities, leading the sales process from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close
Lead thoughtful discovery conversations with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers to understand their business objectives, growth constraints, marketing challenges, and commercial priorities
Look beyond individual campaigns to understand the broader business, including customer acquisition, retention, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, channel mix, and profitability
Identify where Acceler8 can create meaningful value across paid media, creative strategy, measurement, conversion, channel expansion, or broader growth strategy
Navigate conversations with prospects who may already have an internal marketing team or agency partner, building a credible case for why a different approach may drive stronger results
Develop and present tailored proposals that connect Acceler8’s services directly to the prospect’s business goals and growth opportunities
Partner closely with our Growth Development Representative on lead quality, Ideal Customer Profile refinement, prospect insights, and opportunities moving through the pipeline
Collaborate with Acceler8’s leadership team on sales strategy, pricing, proposals, and high-value opportunities
Maintain disciplined CRM management and accurate visibility across opportunities, conversion, expected revenue, and pipeline health
Use HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Workspace, and other sales and prospecting tools to research opportunities and maintain an organized sales process
Represent Acceler8 at conferences, dinners, networking events, and other opportunities to build relationships and strengthen our presence in the market

s.h: You’ll thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Have 5-10 years of experience in business development or sales, including at least 3 years working within a media, advertising, performance marketing, ecommerce, or growth-focused agency environment
Have sold marketing or agency services and understand how DTC and ecommerce businesses grow, not simply how individual advertising campaigns are managed
Can confidently discuss metrics such as revenue, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, retention, and contribution margin, and understand how they connect to the economics of a business
Understand how paid media fits into a broader growth strategy spanning creative, conversion, retention, promotions, merchandising, CRM, organic channels, marketplaces, and other acquisition channels
Can look at a business, ask intelligent questions, identify potential growth constraints, and translate those challenges into opportunities Acceler8 may be able to solve
Are a strong consultative seller who can build credibility with founders and senior marketing leaders without relying on a scripted pitch
Are comfortable selling into organizations that may already have an agency or internal marketing team and navigating the complexity involved in making a change
Have experience using a modern sales stack, including CRM, lead sourcing, enrichment, LinkedIn prospecting, and pipeline reporting
Have a builder’s mindset and are comfortable being hands-on across research, discovery, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, and closing
Are curious, strategic, tenacious, and organized, and care about winning the right clients and building relationships that last
Live in the US (we’re a remote-first team)
Why Acceler8 Labs ?
We built Acceler8 to bridge the gap between agencies and brands, replacing complexity with clarity and collaboration.
Our model is rooted in three pillars: Fuel (media), Spark (creative), and Insight (analytics), each designed to move faster, think smarter, and deliver measurable impact.
Here you’ll have the room to experiment, fail fast, and learn even faster. Your ideas won’t get lost in a Slack thread. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, curiosity, and craftsmanship.
We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves.

Remote workdays so you can design a schedule that works for your rhythm
Comprehensive benefits to make sure you and your family are supported, healthy, and cared for
Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title
Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work
The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you
If you’re ready to lead a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

In this role, you will partner closely with the Ad Sales account team. You will be responsible for ensuring that campaigns and customers are set up for success. This role requires a high level of operational excellence to ensure our campaigns launch as planned to meet client expectations.

This role is highly collaborative, working as an extension of the core account team: Account Executives, Sales Account Managers, and Creative & Campaign Managers.

· Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions
· Partner with sales account teams to create media strategies and surface opportunities to improve campaign performance or success
· Manage end-to-end campaign launches including: strategizing and creating initial media plans, forecasting cross-product and cross-channel campaigns for optimal media mix, educating advertisers on ad placement requirements/opportunities
· Work cross-functionally with Sales, Campaign & Creative Managers & Ad Operations to ensure accurate campaign booking and set up.
· Accelerate prospecting of advertiser onboarding and/or reactivation, owning pre-launch campaign activities (i.e. forecasting, media planning)
· Support campaign optimization recommendations and product expansion through cross-channel forecasts, insights, and media proposals showcasing optimal media mix
· Provide sales team with support for prospecting new business by providing inventory forecasts across Amazon Ads suite
· Act as measurement consultant for campaigns based on customer KPIs
· Execute measurement set-up to ensure campaign success
· Partner with sales team to strategically grow partnerships, providing mid-campaign and end-of-campaign reporting and insights, and owning campaign measurement analyses.
· Create campaign reporting using Amazon and third-party data, surfacing any opportunities to improve performance based on client KPIs
A day in the life
You will earn trust and foster frustration-free advertiser experiences by partnering with Amazon sales teams (Account Executives, Sales Account Managers, and Campaign & Creative Managers) to create media proposals for advertisers that are new to Amazon Ads.

You will strategize and build media plans aimed at helping advertisers grow their business and marketing objectives while upholding our end customers’ experience. You will work with internal stakeholders to deliver reporting and actionable insights that matter to our advertisers.

During the pre-sales process, Account Managers create media plans that will meet advertisers campaign goals and KPIs and identify any opportunities for Account Executives to present strategic opportunities, whether that is through measurement or product expansion.

You will oversee Amazon first-party and third-party measurement set up pre-launch and the deliver campaign metrics and reporting during and/or after the campaign ends. You will use data to provide account teams with strategic opportunities that they can take to our customers.

The role provides a fast-paced environment that offers team members continual opportunities to learn, be curious and develop their skills.

This role may support various categories/verticals based upon the needs of Large Customer Sales business. The role still focus especially on Amazon's video activations, including Prime Video Ads and other Streaming TV opportunities. Account Managers work with AEs, AMs, CCMs, AdOps, Measurement, among other teams to ensure flawless campaign execution.

· Bachelor's degree

· Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights

Einleitung Schranken, Papiertickets, Parkscheiben – das war gestern. Heute bauen wir smarte Mobility Hubs, morgen die größten Enterprise-Deals der Parkbranche.

Dafür suchen wir keinen Farmer, der bestehende Accounts hegt, sondern einen echten Hunter: Als eine:r unserer ersten Senior Account Executives im brandneuen Enterprise-Team baust Du unsere Enterprise-Sales-Motion in Deutschland komplett neu auf: Zielaccounts, Ansprache-Strategie, erster unterschriebener Vertrag, alles mit Deiner Handschrift.

Im Zentrum steht eine klar definierte Named Account List (NAL) der wichtigsten Enterprise-Player Deutschlands, zu denen Du Dir proaktiv den Weg zu den relevanten Entscheider:innen bahnst, Hand in Hand mit unserem Marketing-Team und dessen ABM-Kampagnen.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung, unserem VP Sales sowie unserem neuen Head of Enterprise Sales zusammen.
Was ist Deine Aufgabe? Du baust die Enterprise-Sales-Motion in Deutschland von null auf. Prozesse, Ansprache-Strategie und Playbooks entstehen mit Dir.
Du entwickelst und bespielst unsere Named Account List (NAL) und verschaffst Dir über Multi-Threading Zugang zu allen relevanten Entscheider:innen.
Du gehst outbound first auf Kundenjagd: Kaltakquise, Netzwerken, Events, gemeinsame ABM-Kampagnen mit Marketing. Leads wartest Du nicht ab, Du machst sie.
Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales-Cycle: von Video-Call und Vor-Ort-Demo bis Vertragsabschluss und Übergabe an unser Operations-Team.
Du berätst bis auf C-Level zu Verträgen, Technik, Mobilitätskonzepten, Ausschreibungen und Partnerschaften und gibst Kundenfeedback direkt an unser Produkt-Team weiter.
Du baust gemeinsam mit Geschäftsführung, VP Sales und Head of Enterprise Sales das Team auf und coachst künftig auch (Junior) Account Executives.
Du repräsentierst Peter Park bei strategischen Terminen und Branchenevents.
Deine Fähigkeiten: Waschechter Hunter & Connector: Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen aufbauen ist für Dich kein Aufwand, sondern Hobby. Du bist pragmatisch und street smart.
Riesige Resilience: Lange Sales-Cycles und Rückschläge spornen Dich an, statt Dich zu bremsen.
Senior Room Presence: Vorstandsetagen sind für Dich Wohnzimmer, nicht Bühnenangst.
Influencer & Persuader: Du überzeugst mit Substanz und Charisma, nicht mit Druck.
Komplexität schreckt Dich nicht, sie reizt Dich. Du schneidest Dich durch wie ein heißes Messer durch Butter.
Nachgewiesene quantitative Erfolgsbilanz im Knacken von Quotas und Greenfield-Territorien. Net-New-Logos statt warmer Leads. Top-Performer-Auszeichnungen? Gerne erzählen.
Sattelfest in MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale & Co., mit einer CRM-Pipeline, die nicht lügt (Hubspot, Salesforce).
5+ Jahre B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Enterprise-/Named-Account-Erfahrung; Erfahrung mit Hardware+Software-Lösungen (IoT, Sensorik) ist ein Plus, kein Muss.
Erfahrung mit Account-Based Marketing oder enger Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing-Teams an Zielaccount-Strategien.
Unternehmerischer Kopf, der mit Ambiguität tanzt statt zu zögern. Ein Studium ist nett, aber kein Muss.
Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
Reisebereitschaft: ca. 50 % (deutschlandweit) für Termine mit Deinen Target Accounts
Neu aufgebautes Enterprise-Team. Du gehörst zu den Ersten
Reporting an unseren neuen Head of Sales, Enterprise

Think Big: Wir denken in Portfolios, nicht in Einzeldeals.
Bias for Action: Wir entscheiden schnell und justieren im Gehen nach.

Vertrauensbasiertes, flexibles Arbeiten im Office mit Alpenblick in der neuen Balan oder remote.

Build and manage a self-sourced pipeline at 3x coverage against quota, largely through your own outbound.

Comfort running a challenger sales style: you bring insight and create urgency rather than waiting for the buyer to move.

CWS\-Hygiene ist Marktführer im Bereich der Waschraumhygiene und ein Vorreiter in Sachen Nachhaltigkeit in unserer Branche. Wahrscheinlich hast Du uns schon in den Waschräumen in Restaurants gesehen oder unsere Fussmatten am Eingang von Einkaufsläden bemerkt. Du findest uns überall – sei es vor Ort oder auf der Strasse, wo Du regelmässig unsere Servicefahrzeuge siehst. Zur Verstärkung unseres Sales\-Teams im Bereich Hygiene suchen wir dich!
Deine Aufgaben als
Key Account Manager Lead CH (m/w/d)
In Deiner Rolle als Key Account Manager Lead verantwortest Du die strategische und operative Weiterentwicklung des schweizweiten Key Account Managements im Bereich CWS Hygiene. Du stellst eine klare Kundenstrategie sowie die Steuerung der Ziele sicher.

Mit einem starken Fokus auf Umsatz, Marge und nachhaltige Kundenentwicklung führst und entwickelst Du das KAM\-Team, etablierst professionelle Steuerungsinstrumente und sorgst für eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit den relevanten internen Schnittstellen.
Deine Rolle bei uns als Key Account Manager Lead
Du verantwortest die Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der CWS\-Hygiene\-KAM\-Strategie und stellst eine klare Kundenselektion, Segmentierung und Kundenownership sicher
Ebenfalls gehören die Rekrutierung, das Onboarding sowie die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung und gezielte Entwicklung des schweizweiten KAM\-Teams zu deinen Aufgaben. Du stellst durch eine nachhaltige Talent\- und Nachfolgeplanung die langfristige Leistungsfähigkeit des Teams sicher
Du trägst die Verantwortung für Umsatz, Marge, Retention, Cross\-Selling und die strategische Entwicklung des KAM\-Portfolios und steuerst aktiv Forecast, Pipeline sowie Vertragsverlängerungen
Du führst die KAM\-Scorecard ein und steuerst deren kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung. Zudem wirkst Du bei der jährlichen Kalibrierung des Ziel\- und Provisionsmodells mit und führst regelmässige Performance Reviews mit den KAM Mitarbeitenden durch
Ebenfalls stellst Du eine klare Governance zwischen KAM, regionalem Aussendienst, Customer Service, Operations, Finance und Marketing sicher und klärst Ownership\-, Pricing\- und Eskalationsfragen über die relevanten Schnittstellen hinweg
Du steuerst die Preis\- und Margendisziplin im KAM\-Portfolio innerhalb der definierten Leitplanken und verantwortest strategische Vertragsverlängerungen, Ausschreibungen sowie die frühzeitige Identifikation und Steuerung von Erosionsrisiken
Zu guter Letzt baust Du ein aussagekräftiges KAM\-Reporting auf, analysierst relevante Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Massnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kundenentwicklung und Vertriebsperformance ab. Gleichzeitig stellst Du eine konsequente CRM\-/Salesforce\-Disziplin sowie den systematischen Austausch von Markt\- und Kundenfeedback sicher
Wie stellst Du sicher, dass wir den besten Service bieten?
Wir bei CWS\-Hygiene glauben, dass es entscheidend ist, dass Du sowohl persönlich als auch zu unserer Firmenkultur passt. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Dienstleistungslösungen, willst der/die Beste sein und bringst eine hohe Einsatzbereitschaft mit. Du bist in der Lage, die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu erkennen und in erstklassige Lösungen umzusetzen.
Darüber hinaus bringst Du folgende Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen mit:
Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Berufsausbildung mit relevanter Weiterbildung in Verkauf, Betriebswirtschaft, Führung oder Key Account Management
Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im B2B\-Key\-Account\-Management oder in einer vergleichbaren strategischen Vertriebsfunktion sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung, Entwicklung und Performance\-Steuerung von Vertriebsteams
Fundiertes Verständnis im strategischen B2B\-Key\-Account\-Management, im Umgang mit komplexen Kundenstrukturen, mehrjährigen Verträgen, Ausschreibungen und Multi\-Stakeholder\-Verhandlungen
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Margensteuerung, Preisverhandlung sowie im Forecasting und Angebots\- und Vertragsmanagement
Sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in CRM\-/Salesforce\-Systemen zur Steuerung von Pipeline, Kundensegmentierung, Account Plans und KPIs sowie sehr gute MS\-Office\-Kenntnisse
Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; ösischkenntnisse von Vorteil
Was haben wir dir zu bieten
Bei CWS Hygiene zu arbeiten bedeutet, Teil eines dynamischen und herausfordernden Umfelds zu sein, in dem kein Tag wie der andere ist. Als Teil eines grossen europäischen Unternehmens hast Du die Möglichkeit, viel zu lernen und Dich stetig weiterzuentwickeln. Unsere Grundwerte: Der Kunde steht an erster Stelle, wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, werden jeden Tag besser, übernehmen Verantwortung und streben nach Erfolg.
Du erhältst eine individuelle Einarbeitung
Wir bieten dir einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem erfolgsorientierten Unternehmen
Es erwartet dich eine moderne IT\-Komplettausstattung sowie ein Firmenfahrzeug
Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, 5 Wochen Urlaub, sowie weitere Company Benefits warten auf dich
Wir nehmen dich mit auf unserem Erfolgskurs als Marktführer mit etabliertem Portfolio, laufenden Innovationen und zukunftsgerichteten Hygienelösungen

Mit innovativen, nachhaltigen und digitalisierten Servicelösungen sorgt CWS Hygiene für Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Schutz am Arbeitsplatz und im öffentlichen Raum.

Die Komplettlösungen umfassen Hand\- und Toilettenhygiene von kleinen Waschräumen bis zu grossen Sanitäranlagen sowie saubere Eingangs\- und Ausgangsbereiche mit Matten in Gebäudekomplexen, öffentlichen Gebäuden und Industrieanlagen.

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.

You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.

You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.

You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Spreedly, you’ll act as a strategic advisor and growth partner to a defined portfolio of high-value customers. You’ll own retention and expansion across complex accounts and build multi-threaded relationships that uncover value and strengthen customer commitment.

This role requires curiosity and commercial discipline, blending relationship development with commercial execution. It requires the ability to manage both transactional details and strategic outcomes.
You will succeed by proactively aligning stakeholders, identifying opportunities for value improvement or acceleration, and guiding customers through Spreedly’s evolving platform.

Your role will contribute to Spreedly’s growth by driving insights at the account level, expanding relationships with stakeholders, and ensuring that customers fully realize the benefits of our payments orchestration platform.

Achieving success requires a thoughtful and consultative approach, along with the ability to support alignment across different functions. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, enjoys solving customer challenges, and is energized by a culture of continuous learning and growth.
This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

Own a book of high-value customer accounts (~$3M+ in ARR)
Lead account planning and deliver quarterly business reviews with clear success metrics
Build strategic multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations
Conduct strategic account planning and maintain a proactive customer engagement cadence
Collaborate cross-functionally to unblock value and influence internal roadmap decisions
Accurately forecast retention, expansion, and potential risk within your portfolio
Analyze product usage and customer data to identify growth opportunities and risks
Drive execution on renewal and upsell strategies, including contract structuring
Provide market and customer insights to inform GTM evolution and segmentation strategy
Contribute to customer stories, reference programs, and pricing feedback loops
Leverage AI tools to enhance account planning, data analysis, and customer insights

Additional Information

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

s.h: What It's Like to Work Here
s.t:
We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
--
We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
--
Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.

Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.
We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.
Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

As an Enterprise Account Executive , you’ll be responsible for growing the customer base and closing net-new logos for Infisical’s secrets management platform. We are building the #1 open-source security infrastructure stack, and you will play a defining role in growing it!
You will be working closely with our Head of Sales and the rest of the team on:
Understanding and demonstrating our products to prospects.
Developing, managing, and closing business within accounts in our enterprise accounts segment.
Driving the sales cycle from prospect to close and ensuring adoption and consumption of our products.
Collaborating with the engineering team to define customer requirements and communicate timelines.
Identifying current customers with upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
Using innovative sales tools to map, prospect, follow and close your accounts.
Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.

Experience selling software to a technical audience (bonus: knowledge and experience with open source, security, and/or infrastructure sales).
Demonstrated experience in scaling sales operations from the ground up, including setting up sales processes, CRM systems, and building a sales team.
Credibility, and ability to craft compelling cases for change.
Experience in navigating multi-stakeholder sales (e.g., IC engineer, director, executive leadership).

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.
At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

Ihr Ziel ist es, Strukturen zu schaffen, mit denen unser Vertrieb planbar, messbar und unabhängig von einzelnen Personen erfolgreich wächst.
Dabei entwickeln Sie bestehende Prozesse weiter, etablieren klare Vertriebsstandards und KPIs, verbessern Abschlussquoten und Forecasting und entwickeln unsere Mitarbeiter durch konsequentes Coaching zu einem leistungsstarken Vertriebsteam.

und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase von Premium Solarglas.

Strategische Vertriebssteuerung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer klaren Vertriebsstrategie zur nachhaltigen Steigerung von Umsatz, Auftragseingang und Profitabilität.
Führung des Vertriebsteams: Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung von Innen- und Außendienst durch klare Ziele, regelmäßiges Coaching, Call-Reviews und verbindliche Vertriebsstandards.
Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Funnel: Steuerung und Optimierung des Vertriebsprozesses von Lead → Kontakt → Termin → Beratung → Angebot → Auftrag .
Vertriebscontrolling & KPIs: Steuerung anhand relevanter Kennzahlen wie Auftragseingang, Deckungsbeitrag, Abschlussquote, Lead-to-Termin-Rate, Show Rate, Umsatz je Verkäufer und Forecast Accuracy.
Forecasting & Reporting: Aufbau einer belastbaren Sales Pipeline, Erstellung realistischer Forecasts und regelmäßiges Reporting an die Geschäftsführung.
Prozessoptimierung & Digitalisierung: Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Vertriebsprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Automatisierungen, digitalen Angeboten und Nachfassprozessen.
Recruiting & Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Auswahl und strukturiertes Onboarding neuer Vertriebsmitarbeiter sowie gezielte Weiterentwicklung und Leistungssteuerung des bestehenden Teams.
Kunden- & Verkaufsqualität: Sicherstellung einer professionellen Beratung, hoher Kundenzufriedenheit und konsequenter Verkaufsqualität sowie Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen.
Skalierung & Marktausbau: Entwicklung neuer Vertriebskanäle, Zielgruppen und Partnerschaften sowie Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen für weiteres Unternehmenswachstum.
Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Produktion, Operations, Finance und IT zur optimalen Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses.
Ihr übergeordnetes Ziel: Sie schaffen einen planbaren, profitablen und skalierbaren Vertrieb, der durch klare Prozesse, belastbare Zahlen und ein leistungsstarkes Team nachhaltig wächst.

Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Vertriebsleistung anhand von Zahlen, KPIs und Conversion-Raten zu analysieren und zu verbessern

Ärzt:innen digitalisieren, Praxis für Praxis: Dein Gebiet, Dein Business
Du machst Neukundengeschäft, weil Dir der Abschluss Spaß macht, nicht das Verwalten von Bestandskund:innen? Du willst nicht ins Büro, sondern raus zu Kund:innen? Dann ist das hier Deine Rolle.
Wir suchen Account Executives im Außendienst für unsere Standorte in ganz Deutschland: Dein Wohnort, Dein Gebiet.
Das ist der Job, ganz konkret
100 % Neukundenakquise. Du gewinnst Arztpraxen, die heute noch nicht mit Doctolib arbeiten. Keine Bestandskundenbetreuung, keine Renewals, keine Upsell-Quote auf fremden Accounts.
Echter Field Sales: Die Hälfte Deiner Woche bist Du unterwegs. Du sitzt bei Ärzt:innen im Sprechzimmer, nicht in Videocalls. Rund 40 Kundentermine pro Monat in Deinem Gebiet. Die andere Hälfte Deiner Woche arbeitest Du von daheim oder aus Deinem regionalen Office: Vorbereitung, Telefonakquise, Pipeline-Pflege.
Dein Gebiet, Deine Verantwortung. Du bekommst ein festes Vertriebsgebiet rund um Deinen Wohnort und steuerst es wie ein eigenes Business: Routenplanung, Priorisierung, Pipeline, Umsatz (MRR) und Kundenbeziehungen.
Ziele, die erreichbar sind: 8 bis 10 Abschlüsse pro Monat entsprechen 100 % Zielerreichung. Bei rund 40 Terminen heißt das: etwa jeder vierte Termin endet mit einer Unterschrift. Unser Produkt löst ein echtes Problem, das merkst Du im Gespräch.
Voller Sales-Cycle in Deiner Hand. Von der Kaltakquise über den Termin bis zum Abschluss. Kein Handover mitten im Prozess.
Du verkaufst KI, die Ärzt:innen wirklich Zeit zurückgibt: KI-Telefonassistent, KI-Dokumentation, KI-Abrechnungsassistent, digitales Patient:innen-Checkin. Kein Nice-to-have, sondern Entlastung in einem überlasteten System.
Was Du verdienst
On-Target Earnings: 70.000 bis 80.000 €
Fixgehalt: 50.000 bis 58.000 €
Bonus bei 100 % Ziel: 22.000 €
Rund 70 % Deines Zielgehalts sind Fixum. Im Außendienst ist ein 50/50-Split üblich, bei uns steht der größere Teil sicher.
Ungedeckeltes Bonusmodell mit 1,5x bis 2x Overperformance-Kicker. Übererfüllung wird überproportional bezahlt, nicht abgeschnitten. Nach oben ist die Spanne offen.
Provisionsauszahlung auch an Krankheitstagen.
Geschützte Ramp-up-Phase von 3 Monaten , damit Du nicht ab Tag 1 auf voller Quote stehst.
Warum jetzt
Der deutsche Gesundheitsmarkt ist gerade an einem entscheidenden Wendepunkt, und wir sind mittendrin: 110.000+ Gesundheitsfachkräfte in Deutschland vertrauen uns, 25 Millionen+ Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform. Der Markt, der noch vor uns liegt, ist größer als alles, was wir bisher aufgebaut haben. Genau deshalb bauen wir unsere Field-Sales-Teams jetzt aus.
Das brauchst Du wirklich (Must-haves)
Erfahrung im B2B-Neukundenvertrieb. Du hast selbst akquiriert und selbst abgeschlossen.
Du willst raus zum Kunden. Persönlicher Vertrieb vor Ort ist für Dich kein Kompromiss, sondern der Grund, warum Du diesen Job machst.
